thesis_statement: Meta monetises the largest social and messaging audience in the world through advertising, with AI-driven ranking and ad tools lifting engagement and pricing; the open question is whether very heavy AI capex earns an adequate return.

base.summary: Revenue grows 20%+ on AI-improved ads while capex stays heavy; earnings growth resumes once depreciation growth normalises.

bull.summary: AI products (assistants, business messaging, ad automation) open new revenue while capex intensity peaks.

bear.summary: Capex keeps rising faster than revenue, free cash flow stays near zero, and regulation or an ad slowdown hits revenue.

key_risks: Q2 2026 free cash flow was only ~$1.7B on ~$30B quarterly capex; EPS fell 13% YoY despite 28% revenue growth.
Regulatory and legal risk across the EU and US.

invalidation_reasons.price: Close below the band invalidation level (proposed 518.01) on the owner-approved baseline.
fundamental: Revenue growth falls below 10% while capex keeps growing.
Free cash flow negative for two consecutive quarters.

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 revenue +27.96% YoY, EPS -13.45%, operating margin 30.9%, capex $30.1B vs OCF $31.9B, forward P/E 16.6
Proposed band 555.66-609.96, invalidation 518.01; price 746.14 far above band (no_chase)

owner_notes: Price is ~22% above the proposed band high, so the mechanical band is not a useful entry reference right now. Disfavored under today's defensive posture because of capex/FCF risk. A candidate for a trend-anchored band method later. Accepted by Randall, Telegram 2026-09-23 evening: 'theses accepted, continue to repair ITA and PH'.
